headline: New Product Wins and Global Expansion Drive Long-Term Growth

highlights: EBITDA reported at INR 1,384 Mn (+39% YoY/ 7.55% QoQ), beating our estimate of INR 1,294 Mn.
EBITDA Margin came in at 12.20% (+161 bps YoY/ +16 bps QoQ), slightly above our estimate of 11.98%.
PAT reported at INR 534 Mn (+4.75% YoY / +2.2% QoQ), Slightly above our estimate of INR 507 Mn.
PAT Margin came in at 4.70% (-71 bps YoY/ -18 bps QoQ), inline with our estimate of 4.70%.
valuation: Outlook and Valuation: The company enters H2FY27 with improving operating momentum, supported by new customer programme ramp-ups, expansion into higher-value products and improving business mix across its divisions.
We used DCF model to arrive at a target price of INR 609 per share.
watch: Outlook and Valuation: The company enters H2FY27 with improving operating momentum, supported by new customer programme ramp-ups, expansion into higher-value products and improving business mix across its divisions.
GCM is expected to remain a key growth driver, with projects secured from global OEMs, particularly in China and the US, providing incremental revenue opportunities.
